purpose: Determine whether already-paid adaptive-final G10 SF values are widely reconstructible and substantively different from the current composite latest-phase d9 anchor, before implementing a value-only training arm.

cohort.selection: Exact historical first32 closed shards per run06_g10 and run07_g10_companion4; no new sampling or active-tail access.

comparison.baseline: Current RowBank latest phase carrying each phase0 legal move at exactly d9; max effective cp after last same-depth block/last duplicate move semantics. Ambiguities reported and excluded from paired eligible effects, never silently repaired.
comparison.candidate: Strict complete unique adaptive-final d10 or d12 according to recorded G10 gate; ancestors, rank IDs, widths, depth, roster and gate reconstructed. One-move/incomplete/forced-stop cases explicitly ineligible; no fallback or row deletion.
comparison.mapping: Shared cp_to_wdl slope0.006/draw_width120 float32, side-to-move WDL. No mapping fit; no native UCI WDL claim.
comparison.tie_semantics: Report score-optimum sets different and disjoint separately; representative first-rank move never determines disagreement.
comparison.mate_semantics: Any abs effective cp above shared SF_CP_CLAMP_CP separates mate band; cp aggregate sums and denominators restricted to nonmate pairs.

outputs: execution/rows.jsonl.gz: every physical row source/config/shard/game/ply/input identity, gate/phase/raw anomaly and selection flags, current/final values and eligible paired metrics
execution/readout.json: cohort/eligibility/error counts, source/gate/score/game-level sums, stream hash/stats and resource receipt

decision.eligibility: If >=99.9% of result-and-phase0-valid rows meet exact strict selector, consider a broader qualification/value-only producer; below this first inspect failure reasons and specify prospective equal-cohort/fallback semantics instead of enlarging blindly.
decision.substantive_effect: If eligible mean WDL TV>=0.005 or >=1% eligible rows have abs(W-L) shift>=0.05, nominate adaptive-final value as a distinct later G10 controlled training arm. Otherwise lower its priority. These are allocation thresholds, never a strength verdict.
decision.uncertainty: Exact descriptive totals within fixed64-shard bank. Retain source/config/shard/game cluster sufficient statistics for later estimators; no population CI or pseudo-independent position interval for this purposive bank.

resources.retry: None; partial output remains and no completion receipt.

limitations: No GPU, new SF inference, rewrite, full-history encoding or training admission. Current derivation semantics verified from code; this does not certify whole derived arrays.
Fixed historical64-shard bank is purposive and not the current16.4M population. No broad coverage inference.
D12 selection depends on d10 gap and restricted root rosters with shared TT. It is not full-root uniform d12 or an accuracy bound.
Generation results are not optimal-play truth; no outcome fit/calibration or playing-strength claim.
Retain raw phase anomaly counters even when selected-block structure passes; counters refer to whole phase and are not silently interpreted as selected-block corruption.
2GiB address-space cap is stricter than RSS, output cap sampled every2048rows may overshoot by that bounded batch. No hidden resume.
